photos.title: Wild Wing Plantation from above
photos.what: Wild Wing Plantation from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): curving streets of houses along fairways and greens, with dark lakes between the street loops. Some houses have a bright blue in-ground pool.
photos.caption: Part of Wild Wing Plantation from the air: houses along the fairways, with greens and lakes between the streets.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of part of Wild Wing Plantation in Conway: curving streets of houses beside golf fairways and greens, with dark lakes between the street loops
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
photos.provenance: U.S. government aerial photo: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP), South Carolina 2023 (flight tile m_3307809_sw_17_060_20230410), natural color, 60 cm. Exported by Chapter3 from the USGS National Map NAIP image service (exportImage, Web Mercator, cubic resampling) on 2026-11-14; the exact request is in source_request. The image service identify call at the frame returns the 2023 tile.
photos.license_note: Same source and terms as the NAIP records of /submarkets/garden-city/ (data/2026-11-a/submarkets-garden-city/photos.json): The National Map offers free downloads of public domain NAIP orthoimagery; the USDA FSA policy page says public domain information may be freely distributed or copied, with credit requested.
photos.credit: Photo: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP, public domain, via The National Map (USGS).
photos.changes: Chapter3 Realty cut this view from the NAIP service (4:3)
photos.subject_check: Looked at full size by the writer of /submarkets/conway/wild-wing-plantation/ on 2026-11-14. Every house outline in the frame (157 on the county's map of buildings) is on a Wild Wing Plantation lot. No person; no readable sign, plate or house number at page size.
photos.crop_note: The 1x1, 4x3 and 16x9 share crops are center crops of the same 1800x1350 export.
